'''October 2000 San Jose tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Comics & Fantasies, San Jose, CA on 21 October 2000. [[Kevin Shannon]] won it. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1388">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-26-lg-sj-super-saturday-10-21-00d1388/ lg-sj-super-saturday-10-21-00], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 26 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-26-lg-sj-super-saturday-10-21-00d1388/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Comics & Fantasies, San Jose, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]
